description: This file contains test cases for the transcript-tools module, verifying functions like extractToolCallNames, hasToolCall, and countToolResults which process content objects related to tool calls and results.

methods.name: extractToolCallNames
methods.description: Extracts tool call names from message objects or content blocks, normalizing and de-duping names.

methods.name: hasToolCall
methods.description: Determines if a message object contains any tool call.

methods.name: countToolResults
methods.description: Counts tool result blocks and errors within content.
